title: What is the Bible and Its History
summary: The Bible is the sacred scripture of Christianity composed of the Old and New Testaments. It was written over centuries and recognized as canon by the early Church.
historical_context: The Old Testament was mainly written in Hebrew; the New Testament in Greek. The canon was formally recognized in the early centuries of Christianity.
major_points: New Testament: Gospels, Acts, Epistles, Revelation

title: Identity of Jesus Christ
summary: Jesus Christ is the promised Messiah, the Son of God, and the eternal Word who became flesh.
historical_context: Jewish expectation centered on a coming Messiah from David’s lineage.

title: Birth and Early Life of Jesus
summary: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of the Virgin Mary during Herod’s reign.
historical_context: Judea was under Roman rule governed by Herod the Great.

title: Mary the Mother of Jesus
summary: Mary was chosen to bear Jesus through the Holy Spirit.
historical_context: Mary lived in Nazareth under Roman occupation.

title: Joseph the Earthly Father of Jesus
summary: Joseph was a descendant of David and worked as a carpenter.

title: Jewish Religious Context in the Time of Jesus
summary: Jewish society included Pharisees, Sadducees, and other groups.
historical_context: The Sanhedrin functioned under Roman authority.

title: Roman Political Context
summary: The Roman Empire ruled Judea and authorized crucifixion.
historical_context: Crucifixion was a Roman execution method.

title: Public Ministry of Jesus
summary: Jesus preached the Kingdom of God and performed miracles.

title: Crucifixion of Jesus Christ
summary: Jesus was crucified at Golgotha and buried in a tomb.

title: Resurrection and Ascension
summary: Jesus rose from the dead and later ascended into heaven.
historical_context: The resurrection became central to Christian faith.

title: Atonement and Salvation Doctrine
summary: Jesus' death is understood as atonement for sin and the basis of salvation by grace through faith.
historical_context: Rooted in the Jewish sacrificial system.

title: Doctrine of the Trinity
summary: God exists as one Being in three Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

title: Messianic Prophecies Fulfilled in Jesus
summary: Jesus is presented as fulfilling Old Testament Messianic prophecies.
historical_context: Messianic expectations existed in Second Temple Judaism.

title: Historical Evidence and Reliability
summary: Most historians affirm Jesus' existence. The Gospels are early sources, and the resurrection is central to early Christian proclamation.
historical_context: New Testament manuscripts are abundant compared to other ancient works.
